repos.description: An open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal.
repos.summary_zh: Gemini CLI 是一款开源 AI 智能体，将 Gemini 的强大功能直接集成到终端中，提供对 Gemini 3 模型的轻量级访问，支持 Google 搜索、文件操作、Shell 命令等内置工具，并具备 MCP 扩展能力，专为命令行开发者设计，采用 Apache 2.0 许可。
repos.summary_en: Gemini CLI is an open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal, offering lightweight access to Gemini 3 models with built-in tools like Google Search, file operations, and shell commands, plus extensibility via MCP (Model Context Protocol), designed for developers who live in the command line.

repos.description: 🐹 Open-source Mac and PC cleaner. Keep your machine clean, light, and running like new. Fast CLI, plus native Mac and Windows apps.
repos.summary_zh: Mole 是一款 macOS 深度清理优化工具，集成 CleanMyMac、AppCleaner 等工具功能于一身。支持深度清理缓存日志、智能卸载应用及其残留文件、可视化磁盘分析、实时系统监控，并提供一键优化系统服务。通过 Homebrew 或脚本安装，提供交互式菜单与命令行操作，支持预览清理计划、白名单管理及详细调试日志，兼顾高效性与安全性。
repos.summary_en: Mole is a comprehensive macOS optimization tool combining features of CleanMyMac, AppCleaner, DaisyDisk, and iStat Menus. It enables deep cleaning of caches/logs, smart app uninstallation with leftover removal, visual disk analysis, real-time system monitoring, and system service optimization. Installed via Homebrew or script, it offers interactive menus and CLI commands with dry-run previews, whitelist management, and detailed debug logging for safe and efficient system maintenance.

repos.description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
repos.summary_zh: CLI-Anything 致力于将任意软件转化为原生 AI 智能体工具，通过统一接口桥接 AI 代理与真实世界软件。支持一键安装社区构建的 CLI 工具，提供 OpenClaw、Cursor 等平台兼容方案，覆盖 16+ 应用并实现 1839 项测试全通过。核心功能包括自动化注册、元技能发现及 JSON/人类可读双输出格式。
repos.summary_en: CLI-Anything enables any software to become agent-native, bridging AI agents with real-world tools via standardized interfaces. Features one-command installation from the community-driven CLI-Hub, compatibility with platforms like Cursor and Claude Code, support for 16+ applications, and 100% test pass rate (1,839 tests). Includes automated registry updates, meta-skill discovery, and dual JSON/human-readable output formats.

repos.description: CLI platform to experiment with codegen. Precursor to: https://lovable.dev
repos.summary_zh: gpt-engineer 是一个基于 CLI 的代码生成实验平台，支持通过自然语言描述需求，由 AI 自动生成并执行代码，并可迭代优化。它支持 OpenAI API、本地模型及 Azure 等多种模型，提供项目创建、代码改进和自定义代理基准测试功能，是早期 AI 编程工具的重要探索。
repos.summary_en: gpt-engineer is a CLI platform for experimenting with AI-driven code generation. It allows users to specify software in natural language, watch an AI write and execute code, and iteratively improve it. Supports OpenAI, local models, and Azure, with features for project creation, code improvement, and benchmarking custom agents.

repos.description: aider is AI pair programming in your terminal
repos.summary_zh: Aider 是一款终端 AI 结对编程工具，支持与主流大模型（如 Claude、GPT-4、DeepSeek）协作开发，具备代码库映射、Git 集成、100+ 语言支持和 IDE 插件能力，实现自然语言驱动的代码修改与项目管理。
repos.summary_en: Aider is an AI pair programming tool in the terminal that collaborates with LLMs like Claude and GPT-4 to edit code, manage projects, and integrate with Git. It supports codebase mapping, IDE plugins, and works across 100+ programming languages via natural language commands.

repos.description: An AI SKILL that provide design intelligence for building professional UI/UX multiple platforms
repos.summary_zh: UI UX Pro Max 是一款 AI 技能，专为多平台构建专业 UI/UX 设计而生。其核心功能是通过 AI 驱动的设计系统生成器，快速分析项目需求并输出适配不同框架的完整设计体系，支持 67 种 UI 风格与 100 条推理规则，显著提升跨平台设计效率与一致性。
repos.summary_en: UI UX Pro Max is an AI skill delivering intelligent design solutions for professional UI/UX across multiple platforms. Its flagship Design System Generator uses AI reasoning to instantly analyze project requirements and generate tailored, framework-agnostic design systems, supporting 67 UI styles and 100 reasoning rules for efficient cross-platform design.

repos.description: Fish-like autosuggestions for zsh
repos.summary_zh: zsh-autosuggestions 为 zsh 终端提供类 Fish 的实时命令建议功能，基于历史记录和补全引擎智能生成建议。支持自定义高亮样式与建议策略，可无缝集成 Oh My Zsh，显著提升命令行输入效率与用户体验。
repos.summary_en: zsh-autosuggestions delivers Fish-like real-time command suggestions for zsh, leveraging history and completion engines. Features customizable highlighting and multiple suggestion strategies, integrates seamlessly with Oh My Zsh to boost terminal productivity.

repos.description: UniGetUI: The Graphical Interface for your package managers. Could be terribly described as a package manager manager to manage your package managers
repos.summary_zh: UniGetUI 是 Windows 平台的多合一包管理器图形化界面，支持 WinGet、Scoop、Chocolatey、Pip、Npm 等主流 CLI 工具。Devolutions 收购后强化了企业级安全与维护投入，提供统一界面管理软件安装、更新与卸载，兼顾社区驱动与长期发展。
repos.summary_en: UniGetUI is a graphical interface for popular CLI package managers on Windows, including WinGet, Scoop, Chocolatey, Pip, Npm, and more. Developed by Martí Climent and now stewarded by Devolutions, it offers unified software discovery, installation, update, and uninstallation while ensuring security and enterprise readiness.

repos.description: Lovely console emulator package for Windows
repos.summary_zh: Cmder 是一款专为 Windows 设计的轻量级终端模拟器，基于 ConEmu 深度优化，集成 Monokai 配色、clink 增强命令行及自定义提示符。其核心优势在于完全便携性，无外部依赖，支持 USB 存储或云同步，内置 wget、curl、git 等工具，适合开发者随时随地高效使用命令行环境。
repos.summary_en: Cmder is a portable console emulator for Windows, built on ConEmu with major enhancements including Monokai color scheme, clink integration, and customizable prompts. It offers zero external dependencies, ideal for USB drives or cloud storage, and includes tools like wget, curl, and git for seamless command-line productivity.

repos.description: A complete and graceful API for Wechat. 微信个人号接口、微信机器人及命令行微信，三十行即可自定义个人号机器人。
repos.summary_zh: itchat 是一个基于 Python 的微信个人号完整 API，支持微信机器人开发、命令行微信及自动化操作。通过简单代码即可实现消息收发、好友管理、附件下载、群聊处理等功能，支持多开、热重载、命令行二维码显示等高级特性，适合快速构建个性化微信应用。
repos.summary_en: itchat is a complete and elegant Python API for WeChat personal accounts, enabling easy development of WeChat bots, command-line WeChat, and automation. It supports message handling, friend management, file downloads, group chat processing, multi-instance operation, hot reload, and command-line QR code display, ideal for building custom WeChat applications quickly.

repos.description: A command-line tool for tweaking WeChat - 首款微信 macOS 客户端撤回拦截与多开 🔨
repos.summary_zh: WeChatTweak 是一款专为 macOS 设计的命令行工具，支持微信客户端撤回消息拦截、阻止自动更新及多开功能，通过二进制补丁技术实现原生应用增强，显著提升微信使用灵活性与隐私保护。
repos.summary_en: WeChatTweak is a command-line tool for macOS that enables WeChat enhancements including message recall blocking, auto-update prevention, and multi-instance support via binary patching, offering advanced customization for native app workflows.

repos.description: :zap: Transfer files over wifi from your computer to your mobile device by scanning a QR code without leaving the terminal.
repos.summary_zh: qrcp 是一款通过扫描二维码实现电脑与移动设备间 Wi-Fi 文件传输的工具，无需离开终端即可完成操作。它通过生成包含随机路径 URL 的二维码，扫描后自动在移动端浏览器打开下载链接，支持单文件、多文件或文件夹传输，并提供压缩选项，兼容主流操作系统。
repos.summary_en: qrcp is a tool that enables Wi-Fi file transfer between computers and mobile devices by scanning a QR code, all from the terminal. It generates a QR code containing a URL with a random path; scanning it opens the download link in the mobile browser, supporting single/multiple files, folders, and optional compression. Compatible with Linux, macOS, and Windows.

repos.description: Create *beautiful* command-line interfaces with Python
repos.summary_zh: docopt 是一个 Python 命令行接口生成工具，通过编写美观的文档字符串自动生成解析器，支持基于 Usage 模式的参数和选项解析，简化 CLI 开发流程，提升代码可读性。
repos.summary_en: docopt is a Python library that automatically generates command-line interfaces from docstrings, parsing usage patterns and options to create clean, readable CLI tools without manual parser coding.

repos.description: Embrace the APIs of the future. Hug aims to make developing APIs as simple as possible, but no simpler.
repos.summary_zh: Hug 是一个极简且高性能的 Python API 框架，基于 Falcon 构建，大幅简化 API 开发流程。支持自动文档生成、参数类型转换、路由装饰器等功能，强调自文档化、快速开发和测试友好，适用于现代 Python 后端服务开发。
repos.summary_en: Hug is a minimalist, high-performance Python API framework built on Falcon that simplifies API development. It features automatic documentation, type conversion, decorators for routing, and emphasizes self-documenting code, fast development, and easy testing for modern Python backend services.

repos.description: curl statistics made simple
repos.summary_zh: httpstat 是一个简洁高效的命令行工具，用于可视化 curl 请求的详细统计信息，包括 DNS 解析、TCP 连接、TLS 握手、HTTP 请求和响应等关键阶段耗时。它用 Python 编写，单文件无依赖，支持丰富的环境变量配置，适用于网络调试和性能分析。
repos.summary_en: httpstat is a simple yet powerful command-line tool that visualizes detailed curl request statistics, including DNS lookup, TCP handshake, TLS negotiation, and HTTP request/response timings. Written in single-file Python with zero dependencies, it offers rich customization via environment variables for network debugging and performance analysis.

repos.description: ⭐️ A cross-platform CLI All-in-One assistant tool for Claude Code, Codex & Gemini CLI.
repos.summary_zh: CC-Switch CLI 是一款跨平台命令行工具，专为 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 等 AI 开发助手设计，提供统一的配置管理与切换功能。基于 Rust 构建，支持多工作区管理、MCP服务器配置、提示词管理及环境检查，集成 WebDAV 同步能力，显著提升 AI 开发工具链的运维效率。
repos.summary_en: CC-Switch CLI is a cross-platform command-line tool for unified management of AI development assistants like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini. Built with Rust, it supports provider switching, workspace configuration, MCP servers, prompts, local proxy routes, and environment checks, with WebDAV sync capabilities to streamline AI toolchain operations.

repos.description: iFlow cli is a comprehensive command-line intelligence that embeds in your terminal, analyzes your repositories, does coding tasks, interprets your needs across contexts, and boosts efficiency by performing tasks from simple file operations to complex workflow automation.
repos.summary_zh: iFlow CLI 是一款终端内嵌的 AI 智能助手，支持自然语言交互、代码仓库分析、多模态输入及复杂工作流自动化。集成 iFlow 开放市场，一键安装 MCP 工具与子代理，提供免费版多模态模型（如 Kimi K2、Qwen3 Coder）支持，具备计划模式、任务压缩、插件扩展等高级功能，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: iFlow CLI is an AI-powered terminal assistant that analyzes codebases, executes coding tasks, and automates workflows via natural language. It integrates free multimodal models (e.g., Kimi K2, Qwen3 Coder), supports SubAgents and MCP tools from its Open Market, and offers advanced features like plan mode, context compression, and plugin support for enhanced developer productivity.

repos.description: Visible multi-agent CLI workspace for mixing Codex, Claude, Gemini, Kimi, Qwen, Cursor, Copilot, Pi, OpenCode, and other AI coding agents
repos.summary_zh: CCB（Claude Codex Bridge）是一个多AI智能体协作平台，支持Claude、Codex和Gemini等模型的实时协同工作。通过项目级团队管理、命名代理通信和持久化上下文，实现零拷贝的任务委派与广播同步，适用于复杂开发流程的自动化协作场景。
repos.summary_en: CCB (Claude Codex Bridge) is a real-time multi-AI collaboration platform enabling seamless coordination between Claude, Codex, and Gemini. It features persistent context, minimal token overhead, named agent communication, and project-level team management for efficient AI-driven development workflows.

repos.description: ⚙️ Convert HTML to Markdown. Even works with entire websites and can be extended through rules.
repos.summary_zh: html-to-markdown 是一款强大的 HTML 到 Markdown 转换工具，支持完整网页转换、复杂格式处理、自定义选项和插件扩展。提供 Golang 库、CLI 工具和在线 API 三种使用方式，具备智能转义、表格支持、嵌套列表等高级功能，适用于内容提取、文档转换等场景。
repos.summary_en: html-to-markdown is a robust HTML-to-Markdown converter that transforms entire websites into clean, readable Markdown with support for complex formatting, customizable options, and extensible plugins. It offers a Golang library, CLI tool, and hosted REST API, featuring smart escaping, table conversion, nested lists, and relative-to-absolute link resolution.

repos.description: Conductor is a Gemini CLI extension that allows you to specify, plan, and implement software features.
repos.summary_zh: Conductor 是 Gemini CLI 的扩展工具，通过上下文驱动开发（Context-Driven Development）实现软件功能的规范化生命周期管理。它支持在编码前制定详细规格与执行计划，确保代码质量与团队一致性，适用于新项目和现有项目的智能开发流程管控。
repos.summary_en: Conductor is a Gemini CLI extension enabling Context-Driven Development by managing the full lifecycle of software features—from context setup, spec/plan generation, to safe implementation. It ensures high-quality, team-aligned development with intelligent planning and git-aware reverts.

repos.description: A command line tool for upgrading every outdated app installed by Homebrew Cask
repos.summary_zh: brew-cask-upgrade 是一个命令行工具，用于升级通过 Homebrew Cask 安装的过时 macOS GUI 应用。它提供交互式界面、细粒度控制及自动更新检测，支持批量升级、排除自动更新应用、清理缓存等功能，是 Homebrew Cask 生态中提升应用管理效率的关键工具。
repos.summary_en: brew-cask-upgrade is a CLI tool to upgrade outdated macOS GUI apps installed via Homebrew Cask. It offers interactive prompts, granular control, auto-update detection, batch upgrades, and features like cleanup and quarantine bypass, enhancing the efficiency of managing Homebrew Cask applications.

repos.description: JSON-driven multi-agent  cadence-team development framework with   intelligent CLI orchestration (Gemini/Qwen/Codex),   context-first architecture, and automated workflow   execution
repos.summary_zh: Claude-Code-Workflow 是一个基于 JSON 驱动的 Multi-Agent AI 开发框架，支持智能 CLI 编排（集成 Gemini/Qwen/Codex）、上下文优先架构和自动化工作流执行。通过技能化工作流系统实现团队级协作开发，提供终端仪表盘监控、队列调度及可视化编辑器，适用于复杂 AI 项目协同场景。
repos.summary_en: Claude-Code-Workflow is a JSON-driven multi-agent development framework featuring intelligent CLI orchestration (Gemini/Qwen/Codex), context-first architecture, and automated workflow execution. It enables team-based AI development through skill-based workflows, terminal dashboard monitoring, queue scheduling, and visual workflow editing for complex collaborative projects.

repos.description: 🖌 docsify cli tool - A magical documentation generator.
repos.summary_zh: docsify-cli 是一个强大的文档生成工具，提供快速初始化、本地服务器和实时重载功能，支持自定义主题与插件，适用于快速搭建现代化文档站点。
repos.summary_en: docsify-cli is a powerful documentation generator that offers quick initialization, local server with live reload, and support for custom themes and plugins, ideal for rapidly building modern documentation sites.

repos.description: Versatile downloader for audio, video, podcasts, PDFs and more. Available as CLI and Docker | 多功能下载工具，支持音视频、播客、PDF等，提供 CLI 和 Docker 两种方式
repos.summary_zh: vget 是一款多功能下载工具，支持从音视频、播客、社交媒体（如小红书、Twitter）及WebDAV等资源下载内容，提供 CLI 和 Docker 部署方式，具备多语言支持和交互式配置向导，适用于跨平台自动化下载场景。
repos.summary_en: vget is a versatile downloader supporting audio, video, podcasts, PDFs, and social media content from platforms like Xiaohongshu and Twitter. It offers CLI and Docker deployment, multi-language support, and interactive configuration, ideal for cross-platform automated downloads.

repos.description: A CLI for BOSS 直聘 — search jobs, view recommendations, manage applications via reverse-engineered API
repos.summary_zh: boss-cli 是一个基于逆向工程 API 的 BOSS 直聘命令行工具，支持职位搜索、个性化推荐、申请管理、与招聘者聊天及发送问候等功能。具备多浏览器 Cookie 自动提取、丰富筛选条件、结构化输出和跨平台支持，适用于求职自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: boss-cli is a CLI tool for BOSS Zhipin that enables job searching, recommendations, application management, and recruiter chat via reverse-engineered APIs. It supports browser cookie extraction, advanced filtering, structured output, and cross-platform usage for automated job hunting.

repos.description: Deepin Terminal written by vala
repos.summary_zh: Deepin Terminal 是深度操作系统默认终端模拟器，基于 Vala 语言开发，支持多标签页、分屏、快捷键操作及主题定制，提供高效命令行工作环境。
repos.summary_en: Deepin Terminal is the default terminal emulator for Deepin OS, built with Vala, offering multi-tab, split-screen, customizable shortcuts, and theming for efficient command-line workflows.

repos.description: Community fetch recipes for bb-browser — pre-built adapters for Reddit, Twitter, GitHub, and more
repos.summary_zh: bb-sites 是 bb-browser 的社区站点适配器集合，提供 95+ 个预置脚本，将主流平台（如 Reddit、Twitter、GitHub、YouTube、Bilibili 等）转换为 CLI 命令。无需 API 密钥或反爬绕过，直接通过浏览器环境运行，支持搜索、内容抓取、用户交互等场景，实现网页内容的命令行化访问。
repos.summary_en: bb-sites is a community-driven collection of site adapters for bb-browser, enabling websites like Reddit, Twitter, GitHub, and YouTube to be accessed via CLI commands. With 95+ pre-built adapters across 35 platforms, it allows direct content retrieval without API keys or anti-bot workarounds, leveraging the browser's logged-in state for seamless automation.

repos.description: command line interface for weixin-robot
repos.summary_zh: webot-cli 是微信机器人（weixin-robot）的命令行接口工具，支持发送文本、图片、位置等消息，以及创建、删除、获取微信自定义菜单。通过配置文件管理 appid 和 secret，结合 webot 框架可实现消息自动响应与事件触发，适用于本地测试与快速开发微信机器人应用。
repos.summary_en: webot-cli is a command-line interface for weixin-robot, enabling sending text, image, location, and event messages to WeChat. It supports managing custom menus via JSON configuration, integrates with webot framework for automated responses, and is ideal for local testing and rapid development of WeChat bot applications.

repos.description: 让 Claude Code 更易用，支持多配置切换。
repos.summary_zh: auo 是一个专为 Claude Code 设计的 CLI 工具，通过多配置切换和环境变量管理提升使用体验。支持自动配置升级与向后兼容，适用于多账号/代理场景下的无缝切换，显著简化 Anthropic API 的复杂配置流程。
repos.summary_en: auo is a CLI tool designed to enhance Claude Code usability by enabling easy multi-configuration switching and environment variable management. It supports automatic config upgrades with full backward compatibility, ideal for seamless transitions between multiple accounts or proxy setups, streamlining Anthropic API configuration.

repos.description: ActionAI 是基于大语言模型的命令行交互框架，支持多种模型切换、MCP协议，提供流畅的交互式聊天体验。通过终端界面，可以与AI进行自然对话，并通过强大丰富MCP服务端，让AI具备文件读写、网络访问、代码执行等能力。
repos.summary_zh: ActionAI是基于大语言模型的命令行交互框架，支持多模型切换与MCP协议集成，赋予AI文件读写、网络访问、代码执行等系统操作能力。通过终端实现自然对话与自动化任务处理，显著提升工作效率，适用于文档分析、数据报告生成、系统管理等复杂场景。
repos.summary_en: ActionAI is a command-line interface framework based on large language models, supporting multi-model switching and MCP protocol integration. It empowers AI with system-level capabilities like file operations, network access, and code execution via terminal interaction. Designed for automation of complex workflows such as document analysis, report generation, and system management, significantly boosting productivity.

repos.description: 一站式 cpa痛点 管理工具
repos.summary_zh: API Center 是一款专为 CPA 场景设计的一站式管理工具，通过定时同步 CLI-Proxy 的使用数据至 SQLite 实现持久化统计，支持多维度使用量分析、站点签到、CodeX 账号管理、OpenCode 配置可视化及成本计算，显著提升模型调用效率与账号管理能力。
repos.summary_en: API Center is a one-stop management tool for CPA pain points, enabling persistent usage tracking via SQLite synchronization with CLI-Proxy. It offers multi-dimensional analytics, site check-ins, CodeX account validation, OpenCode configuration visualization, and cost calculation to optimize model utilization and account lifecycle management.

repos.description: A CLI/TUI tool to manage and switch tokens & base URLs for AI agents like Claude, Gemini, and Codex.
repos.summary_zh: agtok 是一个 CLI/TUI 工具，用于集中管理和切换 Claude、Gemini 和 Codex 等 AI 代理的令牌与基础 URL。支持交互式终端界面、预设分组、原子化写入与备份，适用于多环境 AI 工具配置管理。
repos.summary_en: agtok is a CLI/TUI tool for centrally managing and switching tokens and base URLs for AI agents like Claude, Gemini, and Codex. It supports interactive TUI, preset grouping, atomic writes with backups, and seamless configuration switching across environments.

repos.description: oag is a lightweight CLI for managing a Git-based AI asset registry, enabling one-command install and   update of agents, skills, and MCP configs into local environments like Claude, Codex, and OpenCode for   consistent setup and faster team collaboration.
repos.summary_zh: oag 是一个轻量级 CLI 工具，用于管理基于 Git 的 AI 资产注册中心，支持一键安装、更新代理、技能及 MCP 配置到 Claude、Codex 和 OpenCode 等本地环境，提升团队协作效率与配置一致性。
repos.summary_en: oag is a lightweight CLI tool for managing a Git-based AI asset registry, enabling one-command installation and updates of agents, skills, and MCP configs into local environments like Claude, Codex, and OpenCode for consistent setup and faster team collaboration.
